blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Port Moody total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Condo buildings in North Shore Pt Moody
Streets, schools and getting around North Shore Pt Moody

items.t: "North Shore" here is the board (MLS/GVR) sub-area name used in the SnapStats GVR September 2026 report, not an official City of Port Moody neighbourhood name. The official OCP areas along the north side of the Port Moody Arm of Burrard Inlet are Ioco, Pleasantside and April Road, plus the Heritage Mountain grouping (Heritage Mountain, Twin Creeks, Noons Creek, Mountain Meadows, Heritage Woods).

Where condo stock concentrates: on the evidence, it does not concentrate on the north shore at all. The OCP describes Pleasantside and April Road as primarily single-detached homes, and the Heritage Mountain grouping as single detached homes and townhouses with a small number of apartments; apartment buildings are concentrated at Inlet Centre and Moody Centre south of the inlet. Port Moody's condo volume is a south-side fact.

Roads and transit: Ioco Road is the primary traffic corridor for the north shore neighbourhoods, connecting south to St. Johns Street, Barnet Highway and the Moody Centre and Inlet Centre stations; TransLink buses run along Ioco Road to Moody Centre Station (Millennium Line Evergreen Extension and West Coast Express). Bus route numbers for individual north shore streets are not verified.

Parks and recreation: Old Orchard Park is on the north shore and is a starting point for the Shoreline Trail, with Port Moody's only swimming beach (salt-water); Old Orchard Hall is at 646 Bentley Road, and the Port Moody Recreation Complex is at 300 Ioco Road.

Heritage: the Ioco townsite on the north shore is a heritage conservation area, where a heritage alteration permit can be required for changes; the townsite was built for Imperial Oil refinery workers.
Health: Eagle Ridge Hospital, 475 Guildford Way, Port Moody (Fraser Health), south of the inlet, is the in-city hospital.

blocks.text: Good to know about North Shore Pt Moody

items.t: "North Shore" is a listings label, not a place the City plans by. A buyer searching City documents for "North Shore" will find nothing — the OCP plans this shore as Ioco, Pleasantside/April Road and the Heritage Mountain grouping, under OCP Bylaw 2026, No. 3522 (adopted April 28, 2026, repealing No. 2955, which older packages still cite).
The Bentley (295 Guildford Way, Newport Village) was filed as this area's named condo building; it is south-side Inlet Centre stock.

One road in, one road out. Ioco Road is the primary corridor for every north shore neighbourhood; there is no second through-route, so showings, school runs and the commute all run on one road — and Port Moody's only swimming beach (Old Orchard Park, salt-water) is reached on it too.
The north shore detached market can print a zero month.

A landslide site is the shore's only apartment pipeline — and it is years out. 38 Shoreline Circle was designated for multi-family use but postponed after a 1994 landslide on the site; the current 61-home application (submitted spring 2026) proposes permanent slope stabilization, with a hearing anticipated in spring 2027 and construction proposed for summer 2028. It is an application, not a presale.
OCP Section 14.4 addresses future planning for the former Imperial Oil (Ioco) lands; no specific active presale project on the north shore was verified on a developer or City page — not confirmed.

Port Moody taxes and utilities are billed separately. Property taxes for 2026 were due July 2, 2026, with a 5% penalty after July 2 and a further 5% after September 15, 2026; the 2026 utility bill was due February 27, 2026.

blocks.text: Townhome complexes in North Shore Pt Moody
Streets, schools and getting around North Shore Pt Moody

items.t: "North Shore" is the board (GVR) sub-area name in the SnapStats GVR September 2026 report, not an official City neighbourhood name; the official OCP areas along the north side of the Port Moody Arm of Burrard Inlet are Ioco, Pleasantside and April Road, plus the Heritage Mountain grouping.
Port Moody community figures: detached median $1,685,000, $608/sq ft, 96% sale-to-list, 33 days; attached median $715,000, $666/sq ft, 94% sale-to-list, 29 days.

Where townhouse stock would concentrate: along Ioco Road in Pleasantside, per the OCP's description of a small number of townhouse developments there; apartment buildings are concentrated at Inlet Centre and Moody Centre south of the inlet. Ioco Road is the primary (only through) corridor, connecting south to St. Johns Street, Barnet Highway and Moody Centre / Inlet Centre stations.

Schools: SD43 Coquitlam, address-based. A completed locator run documented in this area's own research (Baragar, 2026-10-23) for 646 Bentley Road returned Pleasantside Elementary, Eagle Mountain Middle and Ecole Moody Middle (both listed for middle school), and Heritage Woods Secondary. Ministry-listed schools on the north shore include Pleasantside, Aspenwood, Heritage Mountain and Mountain Meadows elementaries.

Parks/recreation/health: Old Orchard Park (Port Moody's only swimming beach, salt-water; Shoreline Trail start); Old Orchard Hall, 646 Bentley Road; Port Moody Recreation Complex, 300 Ioco Road; Library, 100 Newport Drive. Eagle Ridge Hospital, 475 Guildford Way, south of the inlet.
Heritage: the Ioco townsite is a heritage conservation area — a heritage alteration permit can be required.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect townhome buyers in North Shore Pt Moody

items.t: Form B diligence (any Port Moody strata, incl. a future Sentinel Hill purchase): Strata Property Act s.59 — Form B states monthly fees, amounts owing, approved special levies still payable, CRF balance and insurance summary, with rules, budget, Rental Disclosure Statement and most recent depreciation report attached; within 7 days, max $35 plus up to 25¢/page.

Taxes/rebates/financing: PTT 1% on first $200,000, 2% to $2M, 3% above $2M, plus a further 2% on the residential portion above $3M (so 5% in total on the residential portion above $3M). Exemptions: first-time buyers full on first $500,000 at FMV ≤$835,000, partial to $860,000; newly built full to $1,100,000, eliminated at $1,150,000. Worked example (based on $715,000, the Sept 2026 Port Moody community attached median; no exemption): $2,000 + $10,300 = $12,300. FTHB GST rebate (Bill C-4, Royal Assent March 13, 2026): 100% to $1M, phasing $1M–$1.5M, max $50,000, window Mar 20, 2025–2031; New Housing Rebate 36%, max $6,300, $350K–$450K phase-out; HBP $60,000; FHSA $40,000 lifetime / $8,000 annual; CMHC premiums 0.6%–4.5%. GST applies to new construction, not resales. Vancouver Empty Homes Tax does not apply.
